ABOUT The Gulf Orange Beach
The Gulf is the seaside hideaway you dreamed you’d find for a gathering of friends, family or loved ones. A truly enchanting seaside setting with a chic and casual ambience that makes everyone comfortable and welcome. The elegant rustic cuisine has made the Gulf a destination experience with seasonal menus featuring the freshest local ingredients. The bar seems to anticipate the mood and mixture of the moment and with genuine thoughtfulness the staff sets just the appropriate tone. The design features shipping containers, reclaimed, recycled and salvaged building materials that contrast attractively and good-naturedly with the sand, surf and palms.

 

Our MenuWe take pride in our revolving menu. It changes with the seasons, so that we can provide the freshest meals in the area. View Menu

Special EventsIf you’re interested in booking your special event at The Gulf in Orange Beach, look no further.Learn more

PLAN YOUR SPECIAL EVENT AT THE GULF
Planning a Wedding, Corporate Event, Ceremony or Event?
The Gulf Restaurant is the perfect location to celebrate life’s greatest moments. Offering a casual-chic waterfront hideaway that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere for your guests.

Making a Difference
The Gulf is committed to sustainability and do all that we can to reduce our carbon footprint. Our custom-crafted food and beverage menu showcases locally focused ingredients with stunning presentations featuring Gulf seafood from our farming neighbors.

Design Flexibility
Our flexible floor plan works with any vision and design, giving you a versatile space for your unique needs. Featuring recycled, reclaimed, and salvaged materials, our waterfront design provides a beautifully relaxed environment for special events of all sizes.

Casual Perfection
From intimate gatherings to huge celebrations, The Gulf’s natural surroundings and stunning views serve as the perfect backdrop. Host your event at one of our two locations in Okaloosa Island or Orange Beach and let us help you create magic.

ABOUT The Gulf On Okaloosa Island
The Gulf on Okaloosa Island is located in Fort Walton Beach.  The trademark design elements of shipping containers, reclaimed, recycled and salvaged building materials contrasted with palms, sand and surf, creates an ambience of chic and casual elegance that always greets you warmly.
Our emphasis is local ingredients and the seasonal menus take advantage of nature’s true gift to any cuisine.  The bar and music always anticipates just the right mixture to enhance the mood, and the staff’s genuine thoughtfulness sets the appropriate tone for every visit.
It’s the bay front hideaway that you dreamed of and imagined someone would create for a perfect gathering of friends, family or loved ones.

About The Gulf

	
	
 FOOD & BEVERAGE
 Welcome to The Gulf- a seaside hideaway that exemplifies the casual chic atmosphere that draws people from around the globe each year. We offer fresh seafood fare throughout the year at two beachside locations. The beautiful waterfront setting make The Gulf more than a restaurant – it’s an experience that you’ll want to revisit time and time again. Our menu changes daily to reflect the freshest seasonal choices available in Orange Beach and Okaloosa Island, giving guests the opportunity to enjoy something new each visit.
Our chefs take the latest catch and produce harvests to create delectable dishes. Along with flavorful desserts, we offer familiar specials for the children in your party. 
From local oysters to seasonal fish, we serve a wide range of delicious seawater appetizers, side dishes and main meals throughout the year. Our passion for sourcing locally extends to using regional farmers for much of our produce selection as well. We utilize farm to table and fresh seafood to support our commitment to sustainability.
 Hang out at the bar or a communal table as you sip on freshly squeezed lemonade and inhale the fragrant salty air. Whether you join us for a special event or a relaxing vacation lunch, the fresh seafood and local foods are sure to delight!
	
	
 

	
	
	
 
 
 
	
	
	
 
 
 
	
	
	
 
 
 
	

	

 
 
 
	

	
	
 

	
	
	
 
 
 
	

	

 
 
	
	
 SPECIAL EVENTS
 Our venue is warm, inviting and versatile, making it perfect for any occasion. The Gulf would be honored to coordinate all of the essential elements necessary for your event to exceed your expectations. We make magic happen at The Gulf!
 Our flexible floorplan and beautifully relaxed environment, along with a custom crafted food and beverage menu, allows us to accommodate events of all sizes, from intimate dinner parties, to full-scale weddings.
 To inquire about our venue space just click here..
	

	
	
 VIBE
 The Gulf is a casual, yet chic, seaside hideaway where the sun, sand and lush beach setting complement the tasty food, drink and friendly casual service. Recline with your toes in the sand, have a seat at the bar, communal table, or meander about, enjoy the good vibes, views and tunes. We spin vinyl, accent our unique shipping container design with recycled, reclaimed and salvaged building materials and make concerted efforts to practice sustainability and to reduce our carbon footprint.
 The shop at The Gulf remains a destination for a cool, curated mix of clothing, accessories, gifts and home decor that reflects personal style and fuels passions, from fashion to art to entertaining. We are committed, to offering our guests, signature products and unmatched service.
